> I don't think the code style sweep should be done as part of this, it pollutes the history

New PR for **cleanup** part #104708

Can we expect this fix to be merged on the next release. This regression has really hamperd my workflow process on android. 
Seems like from the notes this issue that has been fixed and just need someone to review it.This  bug has been consistent since 4.3 and it would be nice to work with some of the Godot improvements that have been made since then without feeling like I am taking 2 steps backwards.  Thanks again for your efforts.
Not sure why fix has not been released with godot 4.5 dev 3 but is there anyway to get a recompiled version of godot with this correction until it is released officially with godot

It hasn't been approved yet, it is still a draft and not ready yet, you can [compile it yourself](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/contributing/development/compiling/index.html) if you need this in your own projects

But please do not bump PRs without adding new information

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/94422#issuecomment-2806655661
> Typically on iOS and Android, when a UI supports both scrolling and drag&drop, scrolling is the default behavior, while drag & drop has to be 'specifically enabled', usually done via a long press or via a specific drag icon on the item to be dragged.

I'd need to get more acquainted with the Android Godot editor and UI before I can continue here. The UI elements aren't yet suitable for supporting both scrolling and drag & drop. And `long press` is already used for right mouse button (context menu).

1. on Android, it is not yet checked whether the device really has a touchscreen (true is hard-coded). Many ChromeOS (notebooks) do not have a touchscreen.
2. there is no distinction yet as to whether the input is made with a mouse or via touch event.

I think I will prioritize these 2 points before I continue here.

Thank you . I will test this in 3 hours after i return home. Have a galaxy z fold 7 android phone.
I will test this with the stylus,  keyboard and mouse, as well as with the touchscreen to give you feedback if you wish.  I can also sent short video clip if you wish.
